protocol.interpretation: Conditional balanced-growth feasibility against a bulk endpoint proxy; no measured transfer, gene attribution, calibrated probability or promotion.

medium_protocol.additional_inorganic_note: Unprinted supply sensitivity, including sulfate; not the measured recipe.
medium_protocol.arm_selection: All six reported; no arm selected using outcomes.
medium_protocol.buffer: Supply printed MOPS if the exact exchange exists; otherwise explicitly unrepresented.
medium_protocol.genotype: Exact symbol to canonical gene mapping; production GPR knockout, including isozyme bypasses.
medium_protocol.interpretation: Model-conditional phenotype feasibility; no independent gene attribution or calibrated probability.
medium_protocol.maintenance: Model-native ATPM lower bound; never tuned or disabled.
medium_protocol.missing_components: Record every missing exact exchange; do not substitute related molecules.
medium_protocol.observed_growth: Raw-reconstructed mean OD600 > 0.02; endpoint presence, not growth rate.
medium_protocol.paired_rescue: Supplemented growth and unsupplemented no-growth, at the same strain/environment/arm.
medium_protocol.rate_interpretation: Fixed modeling assumptions, not converted from concentrations or fitted to OD.
medium_protocol.scope: All single-organism assays; no-nitrogen controls reported separately; no outcome filtering.

protocol.native_unsupplied: Keep native uptake bounds for compounds with zero environment supply; supplied compounds retain open ports.
protocol.no_unsupplied_uptake: Close uptake of every compound with zero environment supply; sharing supplied compounds remains possible.
protocol.observed_endpoint: Raw-reconstructed bulk mean OD600 > 0.02; does not establish growth of both members.
protocol.paired_rescue_proxy: Coculture endpoint above threshold and both matched monoculture endpoints at or below threshold.
protocol.permissive: Open each exchange uptake to at least 1000; finite pool supply and partner secretion still constrain uptake.
protocol.ports: Exact extracellular model species; all exchange ports predicted, not curated transporter evidence. Internal transport bounds unchanged.
protocol.ratio_interpretation: Equal inoculum OD is modeled as equal fixed biomass fractions; neither equal biomass nor balanced growth was measured.
protocol.scope: Every two-strain coculture, including no-added-nitrogen controls; no outcome filtering.
